scope: isolated synthetic Noise challenge exchange over temporary USB forwarding
limitations: Test supervisor relays the received challenge to isolated Android signing activity via ADB, not through application integration
No Noise transcript binding or guarantee that a response uses a particular connection in a multi-connection setting
Replay detection is process-local and not persisted; no expiration or restart test
Public deterministic transport keys and public key learned from the same test proof; no user pairing or authentic trust establishment
No real data, second phone, production sync, or independent security review
